notes: Days with an international observance (UN, UNESCO, WHO and other bodies) or wide popular observance, with the kind of work to recommend on each. kind: un | unesco | observed (widely marked, set by another body) | informal (popular, unofficial). A date is MM-DD, or nth is [month, weekday (0 = Sunday), which one]. rule uses any_tags, min_strength (default 0.6), media, not_languages and year_max. tone 'reflective' days are framed gently. programme links a seasonal programme in calendar.json. Page-only data: the browser reads it, the Python engine does not.
